ruleDefinitions.name: New User Created Via Net.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Identifies the creation of local users via the net.exe command.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\net\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\net1\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "net\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "net1\.exe")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*user.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*")))
